title: Service Recovery Schedule by Program Tenure (Ostomy Supply Program)
content:
**Service recovery schedule - Ostomy Supply Program.** When Larkfield corrects an expedited shipping charge posted in error against a shipment it sent expedited at no charge, a tenure service-recovery part follows how long the program has been active: the whole calendar months from the program's activation date to today.

| Months active | Tenure part |
|---|---|
| 36 or more | USD 10.00 (the long-tenure recovery) |
| At least 12 but fewer than 36 | USD 5.00 (the mid-tenure recovery) |
| Fewer than 12 | Nothing |

This part adds to the whole charge.

**Boundaries (hypothetical).** 11 months: nothing. 12 months: USD 5.00. 35 months: USD 5.00. 36 months: USD 10.00.
